errors.evidence: The description states 12,82 Euro for 2025, while the figure shows approximately 12,41 Euro for 2024 and 12,82 Euro for 2025.
The description states that values were constant at 8,50 and 8,84 Euro, but the figure shows the legal minimum wage started at 8,50 Euro and changed to 8,84 Euro in 2016.
The description does not mention the y-axis units clearly; while it states values in Euro per hour, it omits specific axis labeling details.
The description does not mention the presence of both pairs of bars per year, which indicates there are two separate data series.
